description: This file defines types, utility functions, and interfaces for handling suggestion results in a React-based autocomplete component, including grouped and ungrouped suggestions, loading states, and result normalization.

methods.name: isItemLoaded
methods.description: Returns true if the item is an actual item and not an indicator that more results are being loaded.

methods.name: emptyResults
methods.description: Returns an empty SuggestionResults object with default values.

methods.name: hasResults
methods.description: Returns true if there are any items being suggested or if suggestions are being loaded.

methods.name: hasLoadedResults
methods.description: Returns true if there are any items being suggested, even if more are being loaded.

methods.name: countResults
methods.description: Returns the number of items being suggested and loading indicators in the results.

methods.name: getItemForTerm
methods.description: Given a term in the suggestions, returns the corresponding item or undefined if it can't be found.

methods.name: flattenTerms
methods.description: Returns a flat array of terms being suggested for cases where that's needed like for keyboard navigation.

methods.name: flattenItems
methods.description: Returns a flat array of items being suggested for cases where we need to iterate over them.

methods.name: hasSuggestionWithComponent
methods.description: Returns true if any of the items being suggested is rendered with the corresponding component.

methods.name: normalizeResultsFromProvider
methods.description: Converts provider results with single or multiple components into a normalized SuggestionResults format.

methods.name: trimResults
methods.description: Trims a list of results to a maximum number of suggestions, removing empty groups if grouped.
